def solve(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgv=C(sum(gi,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(gi,bgv)
    seeds=[list(c)[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    mixed=[]
    for cset in cs:
        if len(cset)>1 and len(set(gi[r][c] for r,c in cset))>1:
            mixed.append(sorted([(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r,c in cset]))
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    covered=set()
    for s in seeds:
        sr,sc=s; v=gi[sr][sc]
        best=None
        for m in mixed:
            for vn,ccells in dihedral(m).items():
                vals=set(v2 for _,_,v2 in ccells)
                if v not in vals: continue
                av=[(r,c) for r,c,vv in ccells if vv==v]
                for ar,ac in av:
                    tr,tc=sr-ar,sc-ac
                    ok=True; cells=[]
                    for r,c,val in ccells:
                        rr,rc=r+tr,c+tc
                        if not(0<=rr<h and 0<=rc<w): ok=False;break
                        if (rr,rc)!=s and gi[rr][rc]!=bgv and gi[rr][rc]!=val: ok=False;break
                        cells.append((rr,rc,val))
                    if ok: best=(vn,(ar,ac),cells); break
                if best: break
            if best: break
        if best is None: continue
        for r,c,val in best[2]:
            if (r,c)!=s or val!=gi[sr][sc]: out[r][c]=val
    return out
# verify on demos
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

        print(' diffs at:', [(i,j,o[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if o[i][j]!=go[i][j]])

def variants(shape):  # shape list of (r,c,v) -> list of lists [(r,c,v)]
    tfs={
        'id':lambda r,c:(r,c),'r90':lambda r,c:(c,-r),'r180':lambda r,c:(-r,-c),'r270':lambda r,c:(-c,r),
        'fl':lambda r,c:(r,-c),'fud':lambda r,c:(-r,c),'tr':lambda r,c:(-c,-r),'anti':lambda r,c:(c,r)}
    res=[]
    for name,tf in tfs.items():
        tp=[(tf(r,c)[0],tf(r,c)[1],v) for (r,c,v) in shape]
        k=(min(p[0] for p in tp),min(q for p,q,_ in tp))
        ntp=[(p-k[0],q-k[1],v) for p,q,v in tp]
        res.append(ntp)
    return res

def stamp_cells(i,o,seedpos):
    # cells in output that differ and are near seed (within distance 4)
    return [cell for cell in diff_cells(i,o) if max(abs(cell[0]-seedpos[0]),abs(cell[1]-seedpos[1]))<=3]
for n in range(1,7):
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print('=== demo',n)
    objs=comps(i,max(set(sum(i,[])),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in i)))
    print('objs:',[sorted(o) for o in objs])
    d=diff_cells(i,o)
    byseed={}
    for s in sorted([o[0] for o in objs if len(o)==1],key=lambda s:s[0]):
        byseed[s]=stamp_cells(i,o,s[:2])
    for s,sc in byseed.items():
        print(' seed',s,'-> stamp',sc)

# Hypothesis: motif = multi-cell object. For each single-cell seed, stamp = motif minus the cell(s) of the seed's own color,
# aligned so that the motif cell of the SAME color as the seed sits AT the seed. Verify all demos.
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bgv=Counter(sum(g,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgv and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]; col=g[r][c]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b] or g[a][b]==bgv: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b,col))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]==col and not seen[na][nb]:
                            stack.append((na,nb))
                objs.append(cells)
    motifs=[o for o in objs if len(o)>1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seeds=[o[0] for o in objs if len(o)==1]
    for s in sorted(seeds):
        sr,sc,scol=s[:2],s[2]
        for msh in motifs:
            scell=[p for p in msh if p[2]==scol]
            if not scell: continue
            # anchor cell in motif of seed color; align it to seed
            (mr,mc,_)=scell[0]
            for p in msh:
                pr,pc=p[0],p[1]; v=p[2]
                if (pr,pc)==(mr,mc): continue
                dr_,dc_=sr-mr,sc-mc
                rr,cc=pr+dr_,pc+dc_
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
for n in range(1,7):
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    r=solve(i)
    d=[(r_,c_) for r_ in range(len(i)) for c_ in range(len(i[0])) if r[r_][c_]!=o[r_][c_]]
    print(n,'ndiff',len(d),d[:6])

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bgv=Counter(sum(g,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgv and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b] or g[a][b]==bgv: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]!=bgv and not seen[na][nb]:
                            stack.append((na,nb))
                objs.append(cells)
    motifs=[o_ for o_ in objs if len(o_)>1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seeds=[o_[0] for o_ in objs if len(o_)==1]
    print('motifs',motifs,'seeds',seeds,'bg',bgv)
    for s in sorted(seeds):
        sr,sc=s
        scol=g[sr][sc]
        for msh in motifs:
            scell=[p for p in msh if g[p[0]][p[1]]==scol]
            print('scel',scell)
            if not scell: continue
            mr,mc=scell[0]
            for pr,pc in msh:
                if (pr,pc)==(mr,mc): continue
                rr,cc=sr+(pr-mr),sc+(pc-mc)
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    out[rr][cc]=g[pr][pc]
    return out

def solve2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bgv=Counter(sum(g,[])).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgv and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b] or g[a][b]==bgv: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]!=bgv and not seen[na][nb]:
                            stack.append((na,nb))
                objs.append(cells)
    motifs=[o_ for o_ in objs if len(o_)>1]; seeds=[o_[0] for o_ in objs if len(o_)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    tfs={'id':lambda r,c:(r,c),'fl':lambda r,c:(r,-c),'fud':lambda r,c:(-r,c),'tr':lambda r,c:(-c,-r),
         'r90':lambda r,c:(c,-r),'r270':lambda r,c:(-c,r),'anti':lambda r,c:(c,r)}
    def norm(pts):
        mr=min(p[0] for p,q,_ in pts); mc=min(q for _,q,_ in pts)
        return frozenset((p-mr,q-mc) for p,q,_ in pts)
    # variants keyed by transform AND normalized anchor cell (rel to bbox min)
    V={}
    for name,f in tfs.items():
        tp={f(r,c) for r,c in set(p for p in [(r,c) for r,c in [] ])} if False else None
        base=[(r,c) for r in range(min(p[0] for p in [min((a,b) for a,b in p)])) ]
        pts=set()
        for obj in motifs:
            P=[(r,c) for r,c,v in [(p[0],p[1]) for p in obj]]
            T=[(f(a,b) for a,b in []) if False else [f(a,b) for a,b in P]]
            k=norm(T)
            V.setdefault(name+(str(sorted(k))),[]).append((P,T))
    for s in sorted(seeds):
        sr,sc=s
        scol=g[sr][sc]
        best=None
        for kname,VL in V.items():
            for P,T in VL:
                # anchor: any cell of T whose color==scol? allow any
                for ar,ac in T:
                    off=(-ar,-ac)
                    placed={(p+off[0],q+off[1]) for p,q in T}
                    if not(0<=min(p for p,_ in placed)<0)+True: pass
                    if not(0<=min(p for p,_ in placed) and max(p for p,_ in placed)<=h-1): continue
                    if not(0<=min(q for _,q in placed) and max(q for _,q in placed)<=w-1): continue
                    # check no collision with non-bg cells except the seed itself, and exclude anchor cell pos
                    ok=True
                    for p,q in placed:
                        if (p,q)==(sr,sc): continue
                        if g[p][q]!=bgv: ok=False;break
                    if not ok: continue
                    d=sum(abs(p-sr)+abs(q-sc) for p,q in placed)
                    if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,kname,T,placed)
        if best:
            for p,q in best[3]: out[p][q]=g[T[0]+best[2].__setstate__(None)][q]
    return out
